items.source: Gets published after deletion of an entity. It will have a Identifier identifier. If the entity is null or not depends on the delete method used.
items.translation: 在实体删除后发布。它将包含一个Identifier标识符。如果实体为 null 或取决于所使用的删除方法，则可能不包含该标识符。

items.source: change - the AggregateChange encoding the actions that were performed on the database as part of the delete operation. Must not be null.
items.translation: change - 编码了作为删除操作一部分在数据库上执行的操作的AggregateChange接口。不得为 null。

items.source: id - of the entity. Must not be null.
items.translation: id - 实体的标识符。不能为空。

items.source: instance - the deleted entity if it is available. May be null.
items.translation: instance - 如果可用，则为已删除的实体。可能为 null。
